entries.title: Genesis 2:1
segments: And the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

entries.title: Genesis 2:2
segments: And on the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

entries.title: Genesis 2:3
segments: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it he rested from all his work which God had created and made.

entries.title: Genesis 2:4
segments: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Jehovah God made earth and heaven.

entries.title: Genesis 2:5
segments: And no plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Jehovah God had not caused it to rain upon the earth: and there was not a man to till the ground;

entries.title: Genesis 2:6
segments: but there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 2:7
segments: And Jehovah God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

entries.title: Genesis 2:8
segments: And Jehovah God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

entries.title: Genesis 2:9
segments: And out of the ground made Jehovah God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

entries.title: Genesis 2:10
segments: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.

entries.title: Genesis 2:11
segments: The name of the first is Pishon: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

entries.title: Genesis 2:12
segments: and the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

entries.title: Genesis 2:13
segments: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.

entries.title: Genesis 2:14
segments: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth in front of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

entries.title: Genesis 2:15
segments: And Jehovah God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

entries.title: Genesis 2:16
segments: And Jehovah God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

entries.title: Genesis 2:17
segments: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

entries.title: Genesis 2:18
segments: And Jehovah God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.

entries.title: Genesis 2:19
segments: And out of the ground Jehovah God formed every beast of the field, and every bird of the heavens; and brought them unto the man to see what he would call them: and whatsoever the man called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

entries.title: Genesis 2:20
segments: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the birds of the heavens, and to every beast of the field; but for man there was not found a help meet for him.

entries.title: Genesis 2:21
segments: And Jehovah God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof:

entries.title: Genesis 2:22
segments: and the rib, which Jehovah God had taken from the man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

entries.title: Genesis 2:23
segments: And the man said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

entries.title: Genesis 2:24
segments: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

entries.title: Genesis 2:25
segments: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
